caption:
NOMNI TECHNICAL PAPER — PART I

NOMNI is being documented as a Bitcoin-native monetary architecture using Bitcoin for settlement and Counterparty for asset issuance and transfer semantics. The NOMNI framework then defines its issuer-designed monetary and treasury functions above that technical base.

This distinction matters: Bitcoin and Counterparty protocol behavior can be independently verified; NOMNI treasury policy, reserve design, Ausarian Economics, and valuation methodology are issuer-defined components and are documented as such.

Architecture: Bitcoin settlement → Counterparty asset protocol → NOMNI monetary framework.

This series will publish the technical paper, monetary doctrine, and treasury framework as separate cornerstone documents.

NOMNI is documented by its issuer as a monetary and treasury instrument.
Ausarian Economics supplies the monetary doctrine used by the NOMNI framework.
